name: Paradise Beach and Castle Rock
description:
Paradise Beach and Castle Rock
Bowling Green Bay National Park
🥾 Grade 4 | ⌚Duration: approximately 9-10 hrs
🚶🏻‍♂️‍➡️Walk leader - Wilfred Karnoll 
📧 RSVP: info@townsvillebushwalkingclub.com
(Limit: 15 people)

This is a moderate walk, mostly along a rough track that is somewhat defined. There will be some scrub bashing, and some
rough and steep sections. The area is isolated and not visited by many people.
The walk commences at the end of Cape Cleveland Road. From there it's up and over the saddle, and through the coastal forest to Paradise Beach. Along the way, enjoy
the views of Little Beach and then Sunset beach.
For those keen to continue along to Castle Rock, Castle Rock is at the northern end of Paradise
beach. For those keen you will continue to the end of the beach followed by a very steep ascent to the Rock or cut inland to take a more gradual ascent to Castle Rock.
Your heart rate will be ever so elevated by the time you hit the high point and see spectacular
views to the north and south of you. Enjoy your lunch at the summit and prepare yourself for the
journey back to the cars. OR you can stay back on on the beach for a swim and a relax and lunch.
Paradise Beach and Castle Rock

What to expect:
People have the option to stay at paradise beach
while others head up the harder track to Castle
Rock. Castle Rock track - there will be some
scrambling required to get to the summit. Expect
this to be a 5ish hour + day. There is space for only
about 4 or so cars near AIMs. So we will be
meeting at a different meeting spot to carpool
before we head to the start.

RSVP is essential. Meeting Place and time details will be sent via email to those that RSVP
